_comment: Reviewed no-growth ceilings for the god functions (roadmap 1.1.x item 16.4; score card 2026-08-27 Maintainability 'Upgrade to C+', of which this file is HALF — the other half is one merged extraction, which is 1.1.2 item 7). `lines` is the AST span (end_lineno - lineno + 1, decorators excluded) measured at tag v1.1.0. tests/unit/test_function_length_baseline.py (fast suite) fails when a function GROWS past its ceiling AND when it SHRINKS below it — shrinkage must tighten the ceiling in the same commit so the baseline never overstates the debt. There is no writer: edit this file by hand with the measured value. It is NOT package data (unlike architecture_baseline.json, which maxim --audit-architecture reads at runtime): only the test reads it, so shipping it in the wheel would be a packaging requirement nothing consumes. Note the strict equality: a pure reformat that shortens a function reddens the fast suite with a 'it shrank' message — deliberate, so a ceiling can never quietly overstate the debt.
